lines: My vacuum blades tear all to shreds... Whirlwind!
The twin blades in Kurenai's hands created vortexes of air so strong they seemed to form a vacuum, which then tore through the thugs who had tried to leap at her.
(Uwahwah!? Amazing!! S-So that's Kurenai-san's Ninja Artー)
Before Mari's astonished eyes, the gangsters collapsed to the ground one after another.
You don't stand a chance. Stay out of this unless you want to end up like that.
Kurenai pointed at a nearby steel pillar.
A diagonal line suddenly streaked across its surface, and the next moment, the top half began to slowly slide off with an eerie sound as metal creaked against metal.
Eeeeeeeeeeeeehhkk!!? Th-This bitch is a monster!!
Having completely lost their morale, the gangsters scrambled to flee.
Hmph, a monster...? What a thing to say...
Kurenai laughed at herself and lowered her swords.
(She's so strong, cool, and calmー She's just amazing in every way!!!)
Mari stared at Kurenai in surprise and admiration after seeing her fight from up-close. Howeverー
Alright, no more distractions. It's time to put an end to this.
Kurenai once again pointed the tips of her swords towards the djinn.
"Book Djinn"ー If you're ready then this will be quick.
My client, that masked woman, is really impatient. So I'll sever your demonic power and seal you away here and nowー
Mari gathered all her courage and stood in front of Kurenai.
U-Uhm... I don't think that Djinn-san is a bad person...
Not bad. Evil. It's a fact that his demonic power has caused misfortune for many.
Uuhh... th-that might be true, but...
Please get out of my way. The last thing I want is to hurt another Taimanin.
Kurenai tried to push Mari aside.
When I screwed up and was in danger... he protected me with his own body... even though he was already hurt this bad...
I-If... if he did something bad, then we can't help but seal him up...
But before that...!! I want to... repay Djinn-san for his kindness...
『What is this...? This is the first time a human has said something like that to me.』
Kurenai and the Book Djinn both looked at Mari in confusion.
『...But Mari. You do not have to worry about me.』
『I've run from my fate and prolonged my pathetic life for a long time... but everything should have an end.』
『Even if she spared my life, I will soonー』
Mari cut the djinn off as if she didn't want him to finish his sentence.
That's all the more reason... you should have something to wish for... right?
All this time, you've been fulfilling people's wishes, haven't you...?
So isn't there something... you want to do, Djinn-san...?
The djinn simply stared at Mari's face for a while, but eventuallyー
his lips appeared to find the words he had long held inside.
